output.summary: The claim was denied because prior authorization was not obtained for planned inpatient surgery. Under policy V2025 Section 4.1, a retroactive authorization request plus the discharge summary are required for an appeal. The discharge summary is on file; the retroactive authorization request is missing.

items.text: Provide a retroactive authorization request (RETRO_AUTH_REQUEST) to accompany the existing discharge summary for the appeal.
Submit an appeal within 180 days of the denial notice, attaching the retroactive authorization request.
Without the retroactive authorization request, the appeal will be incomplete and the denial will likely be upheld.
